name: Confirm outage and safety
description: Confirm the power loss, check for immediate hazards, and avoid downed lines or unsafe equipment.
completion_evidence: Hazards checked and reported if present

name: Charge devices
description: Charge phones, REM devices, radios, lamps, and battery banks while any power source is available.

name: Check battery banks
description: Confirm capacity, cables, adapters, solar input, and assignment of each battery bank.
notes: Label which battery supports which device.

name: Start generator safely
description: Set up generator only outdoors and away from windows, doors, vents, and occupied areas.
rem_action: Checklist update / Event if unsafe conditions
completion_evidence: Generator operating safely or not used

name: Reduce loads
description: Turn off nonessential loads to preserve battery, fuel, inverter capacity, and device runtime.
completion_evidence: Critical loads identified and noncritical loads reduced

name: Set lighting plan
description: Place safe lights in key areas and avoid open flames when safer battery lighting is available.
notes: Keep one light near exits and medical supplies.

name: Send household status
description: Send a concise status update to trusted peers with power, communications, medical, and supply state.
completion_evidence: Status message sent and response/ACK tracked
notes: Avoid sharing sensitive inventory details broadly.

name: Check vulnerable neighbors
description: Check selected neighbors or dependents if safe to do so and previously agreed.
rem_action: Event / Needs request if help needed
completion_evidence: Neighbor status known or request escalated
notes: Do not put household at risk.

name: Monitor CO and heat/cold risks
description: Monitor carbon monoxide, temperature, ventilation, and appliance safety.
rem_action: Event if hazard or medical issue
notes: Escalate if medical or environmental status degrades.

name: Rotate charging sources
description: Rotate devices through available battery, vehicle, solar, or generator sources.
notes: Preserve at least one reserve battery for SOS/comms.

name: Report restoration or all clear
description: When power returns or the outage response ends, send a clear update and reset equipment.
completion_evidence: All-clear message sent and gear reset
